notes.title: v2.1 - Housekeeping build
notes.notes: [p]Housekeeping build to keep the game current:[/p][list][*][p]Minor game engine upgrade[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Steam integration (better handling of Steam overlay and Steam Cloud)[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced build size (improved/compressed audio and game images/icons)[/p][/*][/list][p]As always thanks to everyone who plays the game 😃[/p]

notes.title: Game Engine Upgrade, Linux Support, and Quality Improvements
notes.notes: [p]This major patch brings long-term stability going forward:[/p][list][*][p]Upgraded the game engine to [b]Unity 6[/b] to keep the game current[/p][/*][*][p]Moved publishing to [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/dreamware"]Dreamware Games[/url][/b] to enable consistent build automation and patching[/p][/*][*][p][b]Linux build![/b][/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]controller support[/b] in menus and gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]UI scaling[/b] and increased [b]text size[/b] for better readability[/p][/*][*][p][b]Polished audio[/b]: voice lines are now stereo and sound effects have balanced volume[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]one new achievement[/b] for reaching the finish line... a bit too early[/p][/*][/list][p]This makes NinjaThea more maintainable and more accessible. As always, thanks for playing![/p]

notes.title: NinjaThea: Steam Deck Friendly!
notes.notes: [p]NinjaThea now plays on Steam Deck thanks to latest updates:[/p][list][*][p]Linux build (obviously!)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved controller support (menus and gameplay)[/p][/*][*][p]UI scales properly on all resolutions (including 1280x800)[/p][/*][*][p]Bigger, clearer text in UI[/p][/*][/list][p]I hope this makes the game a bit more accessible to players. Enjoy![/p]

notes.title: Game managed by my studio Dreamware Games - Update coming soon!
notes.notes: [p]I'm now managing the game under my game dev studio [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/dreamware"][b]Dreamware Games[/b][/url] to utilize the build pipeline and keep the game updated and current. Also to make the game easier to patch and fix. There will be a major update coming soon:[/p][list][*][p]Upgrade to Unity 6 game engine[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments for better Steam Deck compatibility[/p][/*][*][p]A Linux build (obviously 😄)[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug fixes (mostly UI and scene transitions)[/p][/*][/list][p]Many thanks to everyone who’s played the game. Little Thea is now 7 and she’s loved seeing her first game out in the world these past few years 🙌🏻[/p]

notes.title: NinjaThea - Patch #6
notes.notes:
Following issues have been patched:

[b]Ultra wide screens (21:9 aspect ratio):[/b]
[list]
[*] Correctly spawn enemies when ultra wide screen
[*] New backgrounds to fit across entire screen
[/list]
[b]Player death:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix bug where player dies repeatedly if caught between 2 traps (like moving saw blade and fan)
[/list]

notes.title: NinjaThea - Patch #5
notes.notes:
Following issues have been patched:

[list]
[*] Improved hit detection: check for enemy hit on every frame of attack animation.
[*] Fixed issue with attack range not resetting after jump attack.
[*] Fixed bug where game softlocks if you die on the first frame of an enemy hit.
[*] Fixed menu navigation bug with "Credits" locking.
[/list]

notes.title: NinjaThea - Patch #4
notes.notes:
[h2]Fix issue on Windows with multiple shift button (attack) presses prompting sticky keys.
[/h2]

On Windows, when pressing the [b]SHIFT [/b]key five times in rapid succession, it will ask if you would like to turn on sticky keys. Fixed by adding [b]attack with Z-key also[/b]. Updated UI/tutorial accordingly.

notes.title: NinjaThea - Patch #3
notes.notes:
[h1]Fix issue with screen resolution and UI elements[/h1]

Resolve minor issues for UI elements going out of viewport on some resolutions.

notes.title: NinjaThea - Patch #2
notes.notes:
[h2]Fix MacOS UI issues and improve player movement.[/h2]

Following fixes and improvements added:
[list]
[*] Fix issue with UI elements not displaying properly on MacOS
[*] Add coyote time and jump buffering to player movement
[/list]

notes.title: NinjaThea - Now for Mac OS
notes.notes: Slay critters and gather fruit on your Mac!

notes.title: NinjaThea - Patch #1
notes.notes:
Following issues have been patched:
[list]
[*] Inconsistent hit detection - Issue was due to input registration, hit detection and animation all being handled in Unity's "Update" method, causing inconsistent behaviour.
[*] Controller support - Correct mapping of attack and pause buttons on controller.
[/list]
